cover: Escalating regional clashes in the Middle East and mass unrest across Europe
cover_scene: A split composition showing smoke rising over an arid coastline with warships offshore while riot police face tear gas on grand European boulevards.

slides.scene: Missile trails streak through the night sky over coastal radar installations along the Strait of Hormuz, with warships silhouetted against fire on the water.
slides.headline: Regional escalation intensifies across Middle East flashpoints
slides.body: The United States evacuated diplomats from multiple regional posts amid rising tensions with Iran. Simultaneously, Houthi forces launched missile strikes into Saudi Arabia and Aden, while Israel ordered major military raids across the West Bank.

slides.scene: Riot police with protective shields and batons advance through thick plumes of white tear gas along a grand Paris avenue during dusk protests.
slides.headline: Mass protests and clashes erupt across France
slides.body: French authorities deployed 70,000 security personnel nationwide as hundreds of thousands marched over rising living costs. The demonstrations turned volatile after dark, leading to tear gas deployments and nearly 1,000 arrests in Paris and other cities.

slides.scene: A polling precinct interior showing voting booths under harsh fluorescent lights, with legal brief folders and ballot boxes resting on a central table.
slides.headline: Trump administration sues over Alaska Senate election
slides.body: The US Department of Justice filed a federal lawsuit seeking to halt the certification of Alaska's Senate race over ballot confusion concerns. Democratic groups immediately filed countersuits, arguing the move disenfranchises voters just ahead of the national midterms.

slides.scene: An armored train crosses an expansive border bridge at sunrise, flanked by Chinese and North Korean flags flapping in cold mountain winds.
slides.headline: Kim Jong Un arrives in China for talks
slides.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un traveled into China for high-level diplomatic meetings with Beijing officials. The cross-border visit follows his recent directive to North Korean armed forces to aggressively expand and strengthen national military capabilities.

slides.scene: Medical isolation tents pitched outside an East African clinic under an overcast sky, with health workers in yellow biohazard suits standing guard.
slides.headline: Kenya confirms second fatal Ebola virus infection
slides.body: Kenyan health authorities confirmed that a 65-year-old woman died from Ebola, marking the country's second fatality linked to the disease. The patient was a relative of the first victim, prompting emergency contact tracing to halt wider local spread.
